title: Ned and the Wet Air
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 4 — Phase 4: Two-syllable words: longer words with two syllables (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 longer-word practice, 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added) — blending words like 'smells' and 'snaps'.

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling lifting his head, nostrils flaring, sensing something in the air.

pages.text: Ned smells wet in the air.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling sniffing the air, dark clouds visible in the distance.
Small cloth bits pegged along a washing rail strung between two posts.
Ned the duckling hurrying toward the washing rail.
Ned the duckling catching himself on the grass, careful not to slip.

pages.text: Ned snaps the bits off the rail.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling unpegging the cloth bits quickly from the rail.
Ned the duckling grabbing the last few bits in a hurry.
Ned the duckling arriving safely under cover just as the first drops begin to fall.

pages.text: Rain will come. Ned is snug.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing dry under cover, rain now falling outside.
